code:
# .github/workflows/test.yml
name: Test Interpreter

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - "claude/**"
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Check out source
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python 3.12
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install pytest pytest-cov

      - name: Run test suite
        run: pytest tests/ -v --tb=short

      - name: Enforce coverage threshold
        run: pytest tests/ --cov=. --cov-report=term-missing --cov-fail-under=70
description: A test.yml workflow that runs the interpreter's test suite on every push and pull request, then enforces a coverage threshold.

steps.description: This is the GitHub Actions workflow, `.github/workflows/test.yml`. The page says to create the directory `.github/workflows/` at the root of your repository, then create `test.yml` inside it.
`name` labels the workflow `Test Interpreter`. The `on` block lists the triggers: a push to `main` or to any `claude/**` branch, and a pull request against `main`.
`jobs` defines one job, `test`, which runs on `ubuntu-latest`.
The first two steps check out the source with `actions/checkout@v4` and set up Python 3.12 with `actions/setup-python@v5`.

The last three steps install `pytest` and `pytest-cov`, run the suite with `pytest tests/ -v --tb=short`, then enforce a coverage threshold of 70 with `--cov-fail-under=70`. The page says coverage enforcement fails the build when overall coverage drops below the threshold.
